chance_spawns.note: These are NIGHT spawns — the Mothman only spawns here at night (the game's IsTimeSpanAnyNight check). At each of these strange encounter spots the game picks the Mothman or the Flatwoods Monster first, so it is about 2.5%. During the Legend of the Mothman spotlight the chance goes up, day or night.
